title: Smoky turkey and pepper pan fry with rice

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain home food: rice, turkey mince, peppers, onion, garlic, tinned tomatoes, natural yoghurt and spices.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday Tesco staple at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan and a lidded saucepan, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: 300g basmati in 600ml water and 500g turkey with three peppers and a tin of tomatoes make a well balanced, sensibly timed dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: Chopping three peppers, an onion and garlic, then browning and frying for about 15 minutes, fits 25 minutes of prep, with the rice cooking alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps; the step's '2 tsp paprika' is plainly the listed smoked paprika given the 'smoky' title.

seasonal_feel.reason: Three garden peppers in a quick summer pan fry suit early July, and the peppers are central to the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced family meal of lean protein, plenty of vegetables, rice and yoghurt.
